title: Medha Configuration Schema (v1)
description: Configuration file for Medha evidential-memory engine (.medha/config.json). Defines backend storage, path, namespace isolation, and registries (kinds, kindSpecs, thresholds, recency, signalSpecs, anchorKinds).

$schema.description: URI to the Medha config JSON Schema for editor autocomplete and validation.

backend.description: Storage backend: 'sqlite' (high performance WAL db), 'file' (human-readable state.jsonl), or 'memory' (ephemeral in-process).

path.description: Path to the store file, relative to .medha/ (e.g., 'store.sqlite' or 'state.jsonl') or null for memory backend.

namespaceScope.description: Optional list of namespaces this project/agent is restricted to for isolation.

registries.description: Single source of truth for kinds, signal definitions, thresholds, recency decay, and anchor kinds.

signalSpecs.description: Definitions for signals observed by the engine.

value.description: Signal numerical weight (-1.0 to 1.0) applied to EMA and evidence.

countsAsTrial.description: Whether this signal increments the total trial count (n).

countsAsSuccess.description: Whether this signal increments the success count (k).

description.description: Human-readable description of this signal's meaning.

kindSpecs.description: Per-kind policy overrides for thresholds, recency decay, and durability.

name.description: The entity kind this spec applies to (must match a name in 'kinds').

description.description: Documentation for this entity kind's purpose and lifecycle.

thresholds.description: Trust score thresholds and trial count requirements for status promotion.

trusted.description: Trust score threshold to attain Trusted status (default 0.60).

active.description: Trust score threshold to attain Active status (default 0.25).

unguardedCeiling.description: Maximum trust score an unguarded entity can achieve (default 0.50).

minUsesForTrusted.description: Minimum trial count before an entity can become Trusted (default 5).

minUsesForRetired.description: Minimum trial count before low trust triggers retirement (default 3).

retiredTrustThreshold.description: Trust score below which an entity is retired (default 0.10).

recency.description: Exponential decay settings based on time elapsed since last observed signal.

halfLifeDays.description: Half-life in days for exponential recency decay (default 45).

floor.description: Floor below which recency factor will not decay (default 0.30).

evidenceWeighting.description: How trials and successes are accrued: 'count' (+1 per event) or 'signal-value' (weighted by signal value).

signalLimits.description: Anti-spam limits on signal frequency and author diversity.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum milliseconds required between signals from the same author.

maxSuccessesPerAuthor.description: Cap on successes a single author can contribute to evidence.

decisionPolicy.description: Human approval gating policy for decision trees.

requireHumanFor.description: List of actions/tags requiring human approval before execution.
